svg.title: Roadmap as a transit map
svg.desc: Thirteen lines of work, six stations each. Agent runtime & harness (Go · Python · Kubernetes): Go service agent, job agents, CrewAI · Agno, OpenAI · Claude SDK, LangGraph, Flowise workers. Notebook & workspace agents (autonomous Jupyter): create notebooks, complete cells, clean up · delete, workspace mgmt, Teradata workspace, harness tools. Scheduling & events (event-driven agents): cron schedules, event triggers, job queues, retries · backoff, checkpoint resume, run history. SDLC & full-stack (agents for the dev loop): PR review agent, feature workflows, e2e pipelines, feature testing, React · TypeScript, Go · Python APIs. Agent memory (temporal knowledge graphs): Mem0, LangGraph ckpt, Strands memory, Graphiti, Postgres sessions, graph recall. Evals & observability (traces · metrics · gates): Opik, OpenTelemetry, job-agent evals, solve rate, token cost, regression gates. Model routing & AutoLLM (right model per task): eval-based routing, AutoLLM selection, cost · latency SLOs, fallback chains, Claude · OpenAI, open LLMs. Governance & tools (MCP · approvals · RBAC): MCP servers, HITL approvals, skills registry, RBAC, tenant isolation, injection guards. Model serving (Kubernetes-native inference): KServe engine, NVIDIA NIM, REST endpoints, quantized LLMs, Helm charts, multi-cluster. Deploy anywhere (any cluster · on-prem): Docker, CI/CD, EKS, AKS, GKE, on-prem. RAG & retrieval (hybrid search · grounding): BM25, Sentence-BERT, FAISS, pgvector, knowledge graphs, NL2SQL. LLM fine-tuning (PEFT · compression): LLaMA-2, QLoRA 4-bit, LoRA · PEFT, Indic-BERT, GPT-2 prompt tuning, ONNX. Predictive ML (60M+ healthcare claims): XGBoost, LightGBM, Prophet · SARIMA, anomaly detection, explainable ML, risk scoring.
